# ankra_stack_profile_share (Resource)

Shares a stack profile with another organisation, which can then see and deploy every version of it. The counterpart of `ankra stack-profiles share add` and `ankra stack-profiles share remove`. The platform re-scans every version for secrets before sharing, and a profile takes a limited number of grants. A grant whose organisation was deleted is treated as gone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_stack_profile_share" "partner" {
  profile_id        = ankra_stack_profile.platform.id
  organisation_slug = "partner-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organisation_slug` (String) Slug of the organisation to share with. The platform matches it case-insensitively; state keeps the configured spelling.
- `profile_id` (String) Profile to share.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the share grant.
- `organisation_id` (String) Identifier of that organisation.
- `organisation_name` (String) Name of that organisation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Shares are imported as <profile_id>/<organisation_slug>.
terraform import ankra_stack_profile_share.partner 7b1d2c3e-4f5a-6b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e/partner-org
```
